description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Sea-ing Green at Rosemary”, a beautifully decorated 2-bedroom condo in Rosemary Beach. Perfectly located, it overlooks the serene St Augustine Green to enjoy concerts and shows from your balcony, is just a 1-minute walk to the Cabana Pool and a quick 4-minute bike ride to the beach with 3 beach bikes provided. Sleeps 7, features a fully equipped kitchen, elevator to the condo and 2 private balconies for ultimate relaxation. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Overlooks the lush St Augustine Green - perfect place to enjoy shows from your balcony1-Minute Walk to the Cabana Pool4-Minute Bike Ride to the sugar-white sands of the beachSleeps up to 7 with a Primary King Suite, Queen with Twin Guest Room, and a cozy Twin Bunk NookFully equipped kitchen and open living area for gatheringPrivate patio with outdoor dining for 43 Cruise Beach bikes includedConvenient elevator access to the condoEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"What a wonderful place! The location was perfect—just a short bike ride to the beach. The porch was the perfect spot to watch concerts and shows in the evenings. Can’t wait to go back!" – Lauren R.⭐"We loved our stay! Clean, comfy beds, and a fully stocked kitchen. The location was ideal. We had plenty of space and enjoyed the nearby pools and beach access!" – Lyndsey R.⭐"The best Rosemary Beach condo we’ve stayed in! Spacious, comfortable, and well-equipped. Perfect stay for our family getaway. Highly recommend!" – Blake L.*** LIVING AREA ***The open-plan living area sets the perfect tone for relaxed and joyful gatherings. Designed with comfort in mind, the space features plush seating, light and airy decor, and easy access to the patio for an indoor-outdoor flow overlooking the Augustine Green with evening concerts and shows, offering you a front row seat.Comfortable sofa and seating areaFlat-screen TV for entertainmentDoors leading to a private balcony overlooking the Augustine Green venue center*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Prepare delicious meals and snacks in the freshly updated, fully equipped kitchen while staying connected with your family or friends. Dinner parties are a breeze with a dining table that seats six, plus bar seating for quick bites.Stainless steel appliancesQuartz countertops with ample prep spaceDining table seats 6 and bar stools for 2 more*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Stylishly furnished bedrooms provide cozy retreats at the end of each day. With comfortable bedding and practical layouts, every guest has a space to unwind.Primary Suite – King-size bed, large smart TV, spacious closet, and an en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower, garden tub, and dual vanityGuest Suite – Queen-size bed with a cozy built-in twin bed for extra sleeping space, smart TV and easy access to the hallway bathroomHallway Bunk – Twin-size custom bunk beds, perfect for younger travelersHallway Bathroom – Tub/shower combination with single vanity*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES *** Immerse yourself in the charm and luxury of the Rosemary Beach community, a stunning beachside destination known for its award-winning architecture and idyllic ambiance. Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or romance, this vibrant locale offers something for everyone.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 3 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 59284
